subtitle: Two chapters and an appendix written under the primer profile
description: A fixture for check-book.sh. Chapter 1 is a valid primer chapter: no header table, four sections and an H3 where a guide or narration chapter would allow two or three parts, short paragraphs beside one past the 100-word ceiling, and the closing Sources and further reading section.
Chapter 2 is valid too, and its paragraphs nearly all run close to the ceiling, which the clustering report names. Neither chapter fails the run, and the appendix shows a primer may carry one.
